_comment: Models metaScreener offers to pull when a local server is running with
nothing installed (D3). This file is DATA, not code, and that is the
point: putting a model name in a Python constant is the enumeration
this project keeps removing, and it would mean a new model needs a code
Edit this file to change what is offered. A copy placed in your settings
precedence over this one and survives reinstalling metaScreener.
size_bytes is what the user is told BEFORE any download starts. It is an
approximation of the published tag size; the server reports the exact
figure once a pull begins, and that supersedes this one.
metaScreener makes no claim about how well any of these screens. That
requires a measurement nobody has taken yet.

recommended.name: qwen2.5:7b-instruct-q4_K_M
recommended.note: General-purpose 7B, 4-bit. A reasonable first choice on 8 GB of RAM.
